adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff replaces `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` plus an explicit `console.error(...)` on failure with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. In the new helper (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`), a failed validation triggers `throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")`, so the previous non-throwing path (and its detailed logging of zodError + MS response) no longer exists. This is a verifiable change that reduces diagnostic output on malformed responses, but it’s not clearly a functional defect since throwing on invalid token refresh responses can be acceptable/desired behavior.
